base_title: Why AI Coding Needs a Specification Surface
description:
AI coding gets dangerous when the intent has no governed surface.

This cinematic brief compresses the argument that generated code becomes reviewable only when controlling intent lives in maintained, validated, trace-linked specification surfaces.

The goal is to make the source-of-truth shift legible quickly, then send viewers to the full visual research breakdown.
